title: Hassan
_note: The Salted Gull, Saltreach. Lines keep MAIN_QUEST.md IDs where they have one, for voicing. Options show short text; spoken is the fuller line he says. starts: the first whose condition holds opens the conversation.

idle.speaker: Hassan
idle.text: Welcome to the Salted Gull. Ale's cold, the stew's hot, and the beds have only got a few fleas, and they're friendly.

room.speaker: Hassan
room.text: Bed in the corner, by the barrels. It's yours as long as you want it.

notice.speaker: Hassan
notice.text: Bandits, up on the rise above the east road. A month now. Nothing comes through, and nothing goes out but salt carts with a hook on them, funnily enough. A hundred and twenty gold, from me and the stall-keepers, to whoever opens the road.

news.speaker: Hassan
news.text: News? The Kesh ride where they like and the tax goes up when it likes. Somebody burned a farm up on the hill. [He looks at you, and stops.] Sorry. Old Faris says the Alik'r are camped at the edge of the desert again, so don't go east alone.

road.speaker: Hassan
road.text: The road's open. Carts came through this morning. [He counts out the coins, twice.] A hundred and twenty. You earned it, and you look like you need it.
